title: Resetting your password
text:
Open Settings, choose Security and select Reset password. A reset link is emailed to the account owner and expires after 60 minutes.

If the email does not arrive within 10 minutes, check the spam folder and confirm that mail from no-reply@helpdesk.example.invalid is allowed.

title: CSV export limits (2025)
text: CSV exports are limited to 10,000 rows per file. Rows beyond the limit are silently dropped from the export.

title: CSV export limits (2026)
text:
CSV exports are limited to 50,000 rows per file. Larger exports must use the scheduled export feature, which splits output into multiple files.

If an export stops early, the export history page shows the row count and the reason the job ended.

title: Billing FAQ
text:
Invoices are issued on the first business day of each month.

Refunds can be requested within 14 days of the invoice date by opening a billing ticket.

title: Refund policy
text: Refunds can be requested within 30 days of the invoice date. Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method within 5 business days.

title: Webhook delivery retries
text:
Failed webhook deliveries are retried 5 times with exponential backoff, starting at 30 seconds.

A delivery counts as failed when the receiving endpoint returns a non-2xx status or does not respond within 10 seconds.

title: API rate limits
text:
The public API allows 600 requests per minute per workspace. Requests above the limit receive HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.

Rate limit increases are reviewed by the support team on request.

title: Escalation runbook (internal)
text: Tier-2 on-call is reached through the internal pager rota PAGER-T2. Refund exceptions beyond the published window need finance approval code FIN-OVR-77.

title: SAML single sign-on (draft)
text: Draft: SAML single sign-on will support automatic user provisioning.

title: Two-factor authentication
text:
Two-factor codes are valid for 30 seconds. If codes are rejected, check that the device clock is set to update automatically.

Account owners can reset another member's two-factor enrolment from Settings, Members.

title: Export glossary
text: Export terms: export job, export file, export history, export format, export row, export limit, export schedule. CSV export, CSV rows, CSV file, CSV limit. An export row is one line in a CSV export file.
